description: Retrieve the current completed dataset manifest with exact download URLs, SHA-256 checksums, byte sizes, count, UTC and source revision. Use for full SQLite/CSV/JSON, compressed SQLite-XZ, RDS-XZ data frames, citations, ZIP, compact JSON, titles/years TXT or frozen statistics. Check complete and is_current; preserve files because only three snapshots are retained. This tool returns download metadata, not binary bytes or a locally attached file.
name: get_dataset_downloads
title: Get the complete verified public dataset
